strings.buffersize_help: Number of log entries inserted in one batch database operation, which improves performance.
strings.databasehandlesoptions_help: Does the remote database handle its own options.
strings.databasesettings_help: Connection details for the external log database: {$a}
strings.databasetable_help: Name of the table where logs will be stored. This table should have a structure identical to the one used by logstore_standard (mdl_logstore_standard_log).
strings.filters_help: Enable filters that exclude some actions from being logged.
strings.includelevels: Include actions with these educational levels
strings.jsonformat_desc: Use standard JSON format instead of PHP serialised data in the 'other' database field.
strings.pluginname_desc: A log plugin that stores log entries in an external database table.
strings.privacy:metadata:log:anonymous: Whether the event was flagged as anonymous
strings.privacy:metadata:log:ip: The IP address used at the time of the event
strings.privacy:metadata:log:realuserid: The ID of the real user behind the event, when masquerading a user.
strings.privacy:metadata:log:relateduserid: The ID of a user related to this event
strings.privacy:metadata:log:timecreated: The time when the event occurred
strings.privacy:metadata:log:userid: The ID of the user who triggered this event
